summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 78/64)

data.turoyo: Daworo we u taʕlo. Kətwole zad zriʕo, azze lu ḥṣodo, mkawamle aḥ ḥeṭe ḥṣide bi arʕo.
data.translation: Der Fuchs war Bauer und hatte Korn auf dem Halme; er ging nun schneiden und setzte den geschnittenen Weizen auf dem Felde auf Haufen.

rationale: First Preterit box, singular agent with explicit harvested-wheat object.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (113/115)

data.translation: Sie schichteten sie auf der Tenne auf <...>

rationale: Adds plural object-bearing Preterit to the new box; the prior Imperativ supplies the loads.
Makes the already attested but unglossed Detransitive section explicit. Existing wheat and money examples establish the state; the crowd is a participant extension.

summary: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (103/53)

data.turoyo: Komər mawballe u waziro w mʕalaqqe bu šalit, u ʕumum di walaye, mkawmo aʕle, li fərǧa, hən ʕal an nigore w hən naḥiti l gab u šalit.
data.translation: Da führten sie den Wesir fort und hängten ihn am Strick auf, und die ganze Stadt kam in Haufen, um das mit anzusehen, die einen auf den Dächern, die an dem gingen hinunter zu dem Strick.

rationale: Fills thin Detransitive Part. Pass. cell with animate collective state; analysis remains queried.

summary: Preterit mkawamle with harvested wheat and mkawmənne with loads add a genuinely missing box. Base forms alone do not constitute box examples.

The inherited Detransitive Part. Pass. examples describe wheat and money in a piled state. The proposed explicit Detransitive gloss preserves that meaning; crowd clustering is noted as a participant extension.
The printed m kawme at PrS 78/65 is not rewritten; it is already represented by the inherited joined spelling. Infectum 88/34 and Imperativ 113/114 are also already present.
No light-verb idiom emerges from the supplied observations; ordinary material objects and locative complements account for the constructions.
Confirm mkawmo in 103/53 as singular Part. Pass. with collective ʕumum rather than a contracted finite form. Its example is explicitly provisional.
Confirm the exact plural-agent/object segmentation of mkawmənne in 113/115.
bis um oberen Ende → bis zum oberen Ende
rationale: The endpoint requires zum; the supplied translation reads bis zum oberen Ende.

summary: A crowd is clustered around a person; animate collective replaces piled material, with no expressed external causer.
